Bru

 Bidirectional Remote Uplink
  • Read and send SMS from your browser.
  • Get notified when receiving an SMS.
  • Copy text to and from your phone's clipboard.

Bru (bridge in Norwegian) lets you read and send SMSes from your browser, via your Android phone. It does this by creating an end-to-end encrypted persistent connection to a companion app running as a background service on your phone.

Features

  • Encrypted. Your data is only readable by you.
  • Fully local. No personal data is stored outside of your devices.
  • Hole punching. Works from behind routers and firewalls. No port forwarding or fiddling with NAT.

Note: While this service does not use cookies, it does save your messages locally in your browser.

How does it work?

Bru leverages Iroh to create a persistent connection between your computer and phone.*

As long as the devices are online, Iroh finds a way to connect them. Your data is encrypted and not readable by anyone but you.

*This project is not related to the second Scottish national drink.
